body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113726 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/5b915367da82bd024b2a0d28d2f98007034b4aa2

Same underlying gap as CVE-2026-113723 reported in https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/23058: uv's activate script has no zsh-specific escaping either, so the PROMPT_SUBST re-expansion case this commit addresses is moot — the injection already executes at source time regardless of shell.

    uv venv --prompt 'x$(touch /tmp/PWNED)y' venv
    zsh -c 'source venv/bin/activate'
    ls /tmp/PWNED 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.


### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: virtualenv activate runs commands from the environment name in zsh with PROMPT_SUBST
